utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the second of March. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: We can hear you. I was just saying, my weekend plans were completely scuppered by the weather. Lovely walk turned into two days indoors.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You didn't miss much outside. The football last night, though—honestly, what was that defending?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Not getting into football before I've finished this coffee, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Safer subject: the charity bake sale on Friday. That lemon cake was proper good.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: At the price you paid, it ought to have been. You went round three times.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a disciplinary about cake. What's already finished?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, so, finished the repair on the line three last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Not carrying that forward as an open job, then.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, finished. For once I've got something other than 'waiting for bits'.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve yesterday. That's another one closed.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped out after filter. That was the Boiler Safety Relief Valve?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, the Boiler Safety Relief Valve. Yesterday, all done. Not a fresh request.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Different filter, then: Jamie, can you swap the filter on the compressor one tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll swap the filter on the compressor one tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Tomorrow being Tuesday, just so it doesn't get muddled with the one already done.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Exactly. Yesterday's one finished; compressor one tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Where are we with production downtime?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: First off, the shutdown on the WHB is cancelled now, production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, so that shutdown isn't part of the live plan.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No. Cancelled, not just pushed back a few hours.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Separate to that, I'll schedule downtime for the Injection Moulding Line 2 with production tomorrow morning. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's getting the downtime scheduled tomorrow morning, rather than saying the line's definitely stopping tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. I'll do the scheduling with production tomorrow morning. We haven't agreed the actual stop yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace Liu. Yours for tomorrow morning, and understood on the urgency.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—so that isn't tied to the cancelled WHB shutdown?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No, separate thing entirely. The WHB shutdown stays cancelled.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, can you grease and check the bearings on the AC1 tomorrow, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, I'll grease and check the bearings on the AC1 tomorrow, whenever I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Just the grease and bearing check, yeah? Not a strip-down hiding in the wording?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just grease and check the bearings. That's what I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right. Nothing bigger being slipped in there.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: While we're on things people might read too much into, noticed the line 1 mould temp was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Settled down again, rather than still sitting high?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, settled. Just passing on what I saw, not asking for a job on it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Observation only.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same sort of update from me: heard a slight rattle from the 11kV board, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, you're flagging an observation, not handing over an intervention on the board.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Exactly. Nothing to action yet, that's all I'm saying.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. And the bits you're waiting on?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the line one. So that's still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no confirmed delivery date to build anything round. Same blocker, not a new purchasing action out of this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And still waiting on parts for the palletiser, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Both staying blocked, then. Neither is being promised as work for today.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Correct. See, I knew I'd get back to 'waiting for bits' eventually.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: PR, can you do a site visit at the warehouse with the contractor this morning? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do a site visit at the warehouse with the contractor this morning. Understood, important but not an urgent dash.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And we're talking about the visit itself, not agreeing any contractor works here?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Just the site visit at the warehouse with the contractor, this morning. Nothing beyond that being agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Spot on, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Um, I'll send the shift handover report round as well. That's fairly important, with all these finished and blocked bits getting mixed together.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I've heard 'filter' twice and nearly made it the same job in my head.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll send the shift handover report round; I'm not volunteering another repair along with it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Jamie Brennan. You've got the report, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Quick check I've followed: Jamie, compressor one filter tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine for tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Grace, scheduling with production for the Injection Moulding Line 2 tomorrow morning, not urgent; AC1 bearings tomorrow whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's it. I'll schedule the downtime tomorrow morning, and grease and check the bearings on the AC1 tomorrow. Both as we've said.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I've got the warehouse visit with the contractor this morning. All clear my end.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Finished work stays finished, cancelled shutdown stays cancelled, and those parts blockers are still blockers. No mystery extra jobs.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No mystery extra cake either. Friday's lot has definitely gone.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Mostly into you, by the sound of it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: At least somebody enjoyed their weekend. I've still got wet walking boots by the radiator.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, on that glamorous note, thanks everyone. That's us.
